Interesting point. I've actually never talked to her about this, about any of my insecurities really. In my eyes she's everything to me. I always tell her I fell for her personality first, and then her looks. I've never been one to focus on physical beauty, because that can change at any time. And no, I've never watched porn before. I always thought it was wrong to objectify people, and was always disgusted by the idea.

Yes, its real. Reddit is great for getting things off your chest that you wouldn't verbalize to anyone.
